title: Readline editing keys in the Claude pane's box
notes: Claude Code: Ctrl+W/K/U/Y, kill ring, undo, vim mode. Pane: plain textarea; modified keys pass through (chat-view.ts:360). Start with Ctrl+W/K/U/Y and the kill ring; vim mode out of scope. Mind the mode-keys hard rule. Size M.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #127: readline kill and yank keys in the chat box (Ctrl+W, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+Y, Alt+Y). Version 2.25.0.
